BEFORE YOU PRESS PLAY

Three small steps.

  1. 01

    Disconnect & uncover

    Unplug cables, remove the case, and disconnect wireless audio.

  2. 02

    Point speakers down

    Hold over a dry, lint-free cloth. Keep the speaker openings clear.

  3. 03

    Start low. Listen after.

    Use a comfortable volume. Stop if you hear harsh distortion or feel discomfort.

A helping hand, not a repair.

Tones may move droplets near the grille. They cannot dry internal parts, confirm water is gone, or repair liquid damage. Never charge a wet phone.

A few things worth knowing.

Does this really remove water and dust?

This is an experimental tone tool, not a verified treatment for your phone. Apple documents sound-based water ejection for Apple Watch, but that does not validate this app’s tones on iPhone or Android. No frequency here is a manufacturer-approved cleaning setting. Stuck dust needs physical care.

What if I cannot hear anything?

Check media volume, Silent mode, and Bluetooth / AirPlay routing. The browser cannot force audio to the phone speaker. Try the Sound test in Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android. A low tone may be quiet on small speakers; do not immediately turn volume to maximum.

How do I add it to my phone?

On iPhone, open this page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open it in Chrome and choose Install app or Add to Home screen from the menu. Installation availability depends on your browser and site access. This is a web app, not an APK or IPA.

Where does my data go?

Tones are generated on your device. The app requests no microphone permission and uploads no recordings. Only your last session is stored locally in this browser, and you can clear it above. Hosting and sign-in may process ordinary connection data.

Care guidance & sources

Follow your device maker’s instructions first. For persistent muffling or damage, seek service.

SPEAKER CARE

A gentle clean.
No shortcuts.

  1. Switch the phone off and unplug all cables. Remove the case.
  2. When dry, wipe the exterior with a soft, lint-free cloth.
  3. For iPhone speaker openings, Apple recommends a small, clean, dry, soft-bristled brush. For other phones, follow the manufacturer’s cleaning instructions.
  4. Do not push pins into openings, use compressed air, or apply heat.
  5. If sound remains muffled after drying and cleaning, contact your device’s service provider.
